data.question: A rental property brings in 800 GBP/month in rent, while total monthly costs are 850 GBP. What is the monthly cash flow in GBP? Use a negative number if it is a loss.
data.explanation: Cash flow = income (800) minus costs (850) = -50 GBP. A negative figure means the property loses money every month.

data.question: You backtest a strategy over 100 trades: a 48% win rate, an average winner of 60 pips and an average loser of 30 pips. What is the expectancy per trade, in pips?
data.explanation: Expectancy = (0.48 x 60) - (0.52 x 30) = 28.8 - 15.6 = 13.2 pips. A positive expectancy means the edge is profitable over many trades.

data.question: Flat A rents for 50 GBP/month more than Flat B but sits empty 2 months a year; Flat B is always occupied. If Flat B rents for 800 GBP/month, how much MORE or LESS does Flat A earn per year, in GBP? Use a negative number if Flat A earns less.
data.explanation: Flat A: 850 x 10 = 8,500. Flat B: 800 x 12 = 9,600. Difference = 8,500 - 9,600 = -100 GBP. Two void months wipe out the higher rent.
